Tomoe Gozen's deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's, Daredevil's, Luke Cage's and Bullseye's: only deck.identity (data/tts/tomoe-gozen.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).
